valor: A lo largo de más de 70 años, dos mujeres cuentan cómo crecieron en Colombia y emigraron a Canadá. valor: Spanning over 70 years, two women recount their experiences growing up in Colombia and immigrating to Canada. Intersecting with key moments in Colombian history, Vanishing Points is a polyphonic composition of mirrors, labyrinths, dreams, and nightmares that question the idea of perspective and the linearity of history and time.
